name: Do I need new countertops if I upgrade my kitchen cabinets?

mainEntity.name: Do I need new countertops if I upgrade my kitchen cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: You do not always need new countertops when upgrading kitchen cabinets, especially if you are only refacing. However, if you are completely replacing your cabinets, it's often a good time to consider new countertops as well, as the installation process can impact existing countertops. This also provides an opportunity for a cohesive new kitchen design.
acceptedAnswer.description: New countertops aren't always necessary with cabinet upgrades, but consider them with full replacements for a cohesive design.
